Details
Previewing

Your budget tracker is ready. Every item on your list passed in a real browser at desktop size (1280px) and phone size (375px), with no errors on the page.

What I tested and how

Automated logic tests (16, all passing):
Money: 0.1 + 0.2 shows 0.30, and amounts are read and formatted correctly.
Validation messages: "Enter an amount.", "Amount must be above zero.", "A date is required.", plus duplicate or empty category names.
Monthly totals, spending by category, moving between months (including across years), and the filters and search.
Over-budget rule: spending 15.00 against a 10.00 budget counts as over; spending exactly 10.00 does not.
CSV output, including notes that contain commas or quotes.
Damaged saved data falls back to a clean start with the default categories.
Browser click-through, run in full at both sizes:
Submitted the add form blank and with 0, and checked that the error messages appeared.
Added 0.10 and 0.20 expenses and saw 0.30. Added income, then checked the income, expenses and balance totals.
Edited an amount and the totals updated. Deleted a transaction and the totals updated.
Set a Fun budget below what was spent and the bar turned red; Food stayed under budget and was not red.
Adding a second "food" category showed an error. Added "Pets" with its own colour and used it on a transaction.
The donut chart showed one slice per category with spending.
Filtered by category and by type, and searched notes for "dog"; each returned the expected rows.
Downloaded the CSV and checked its rows (file name transactions-2026-11.csv).
Reloaded the page: transactions, the custom category and budgets were all still there.
Switched to last month (empty), added a transaction there, then came back and this month's figures were unchanged.
Nothing scrolled sideways at either width. I also looked at screenshots of both layouts.

Budgets are set separately for each month, so a new month starts with none. Amounts are plain numbers without a currency symbol.
